name: Obstacle
description: A solid, axis-aligned box barrier on the play field. Its XZ footprint comes from the sibling MeshPrimitive; the component carries the collision semantics: movement is always blocked, while `blocksBullets` and `blocksSight` distinguish full-height walls from low cover. It has no per-frame system of its own — it's static collision data plus pure circle-vs-box and segment-vs-box math, consumed by gameplay systems (movement, bullets, LineOfSight) via a `collectObstacleBoxes` world query.
